title: Meta wants your next gadget to be Muse-infused
summary: Meta wants Muse in your TV and your toaster, so it's giving the code away for free.
reason: Item describes Meta open-sourcing Muse code (developer tooling), but rule 5-1 requires a link to the repository or official announcement; only a TechCrunch media article (linkHost techcrunch.com) is given, with no official owner link. No other rule covers it.
